name: French Studies Extended Minor
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Depending upon the point of entry, the necessary lower division prerequisites must be fulfilled: If grade 12, students must take FREN 210-3 Intermediate French I.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: If you are deemed a "native speaker", or eqiuvalent, you cannot take FREN 215-3 or FREN 217-3 or FREN 300-3; instead you must take one other 300 or 400 level course.

sections.note:
If A in grade 12, students can take FREN 211-3 Intermediate French II.
If Immersion, students can choose between FREN 212-3 French for Immersion Students or FREN 211-3 Intermediate French II.

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: One of FREN 331, FREN 332, FREN 333, FREN 334
One of FREN 340, FREN 341, FREN 344, FREN 345
One of FREN 304, FREN 307, FREN 330, FREN 352
2 of FREN 407, FREN 416, FREN 417 and 11 more
requirements.note: Any two courses at the 400 level.

sections.note:
Note: A minimum of 18 upper division units is required, nine of which must be taken within the department.
NOTE: SFU students accepted in the accelerated master’s within the Department of French may apply a maximum of 10 graduate course units, taken while completing the bachelor’s degree, towards the upper division electives of the bachelor’s program and the requirements of the master’s degree.
For more information go to: https://www.sfu.ca/gradstudies/apply/programs/accelerated-masters.html and https://www.sfu.ca/students/calendar/programs/french/master-of-arts.html .

sections.title: Course Exemptions

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: It is possible to obtain exemption, up to a maximum of 12 units, from the lower division French language courses by being placed in a more advanced French language course (Placement Test).

sections.note: Students who gain, or hope to gain, course exemption should consult the advisor early.

caveats: Converted automatically from the calendar; confirm with an advisor.
